title: fix(app-shell,console): the tool preview opens the API console inside the app, with its request preset (objectui#10591)
body:
Fixes #10591
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The tool preview's "Open in API Console" link (Studio, Tools, a tool, the preview's toolbar) now opens the API console inside the current app, and the API console pre-fills the request the link carries.

- **`@object-ui/app-shell`, `ToolPreview.tsx`.** The link was the bare `/developer/api-console?path=...`. The console's root route table has no `/developer` route, so its `path="*"` catch-all redirected the author to `/`. The link now points at the `developer:api-console` registry key inside the app in the URL: `/apps/APP/component/developer/api-console`. The path is built from `useParams().appName` and `componentRefToUrlSegments('developer:api-console')`. The query is built with `URLSearchParams` and carries `path=/api/v1/ai/tools/NAME/execute` and `method=POST`. The link is rendered through react-router's `Link`, so the router basename applies. It still opens in a new tab. With no router above the preview (the designer gallery), or on a route with no `:appName`, no link is drawn.
- **`@object-ui/console`, `ApiConsolePage.tsx`.** The page reads `path` and `method` from `useSearchParams()` once, in a lazy `useState` initialiser. It pre-fills the URL field and the method selector and sends nothing. The rule for the preset is written in the page header:
  - `path` is honoured only when it starts with `/api/`. An absolute `http://...` URL, a protocol-relative `//host` URL, any other path and an empty value are ignored.
  - `method` is read only together with an honoured `path`, in any letter case. It is used only when it is one of the verbs the selector offers. The selector now renders that same list (`REQUEST_METHODS`).
  - With no honoured `path`, the page opens exactly as before.
- One `patch` changeset covers both packages.

Nothing else moves. There is no route-table change in either `AppContent.tsx` or in `App.tsx`. How the page sends requests and keeps its history is unchanged.

## Measurements behind the design (the dispatch's M1 to M4)

- **M1: where the preview renders.** In the console, `ToolPreview` renders inside `ResourceEditPage` at `/apps/APP/metadata/tool/NAME`. Framework's Studio app (`studio.app.ts`) names `metadata:resource` with `type: 'tool'`, and the nav resolves that to `/apps/APP/metadata/tool`. Both of app-shell's `AppContent` branches mount `metadata/:type/:name` under `/apps/:appName/*`: the with-app branch and the no-active-app branch. So `:appName` is always in the URL there. The `/studio/:packageId/:tab` design surface lists no tools. The designer gallery (`preview-gallery.tsx`) mounts previews with no router. **Source chosen:** `useParams().appName`, the URL's own app segment. `ResourceListPage` and most app-shell views build their `/apps/...` links from that same segment. For the key-to-URL step I used the existing `componentRefToUrlSegments`. I added no new link helper.
- **M2: which target.** I chose the registry-key URL. app-shell owns `component/:ns/:name/*` (`ComponentNavView`) in every app. The `developer/api-console` path is declared in the console's `systemRoutes`, a detail of one host. The registry key is also what Studio's Developer navigation names, so the link and the sidebar's "API Console" entry reach the same path. `ComponentNavView` also forwards the query as props. `ApiConsolePage` takes no props and ignores them. The query read goes through the router instead, so it works on both mounts.
- **M3: the preset reaches the page on both mounts.** Pinned through the real route table (see below).
- **M4: other app-less `/developer/...` links.** `IntegrationsPage` builds `${basePath}/developer/api-console` with `basePath` from `:appName`. It is only mounted under `/apps/:appName`, so the prefix is always there, and it navigates through the router. That is not a defect, and it is outside the claimed files, so I left it alone. The same sweep found an app-less link of the same class in a sibling preview: see Findings.

## Pins (real components, no module mock of the link builder)

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ToolPreview.test.tsx` has a new describe block. It renders the real `ToolPreview` in a `MemoryRouter` under `/apps/:appName/*`:
- the link resolves to `/apps/studio/component/developer/api-console`, which is the component URL of `developer:api-console`;
- it stays in whichever app the author is in (`com.acme.crm`);
- it carries `path=/api/v1/ai/tools/delete_all_orders/execute` and `method=POST`;
- a tool name that needs escaping round-trips exactly;
- under `basename="/_console"` the href starts with `/_console/apps/...`;
- it still has `target=_blank` and `rel=noreferrer`;
- no link on a route without an app, and none with no router (no throw).

`apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx` is new. It uses the real page, the real `registerDeveloperComponents`, app-shell's real `DefaultAppContent` and the console's real `systemRoutes`. The shell chrome is stubbed the way `orphanedPageComponentRefs-10520.test.tsx` stubs it:
- with the preset, the path and POST are pre-filled, and no fetch goes to `/ai/tools/` (endpoint discovery still runs);
- control: with no query string, the URL field is empty and the method is GET;
- the preset is ignored for an absolute URL, a protocol-relative URL, a path outside `/api/` and an empty value;
- the method is accepted in any case, and an unknown verb is ignored;
- the preset is read once: a later query change does not overwrite the editor;
- **end to end:** the href the real registered tool preview draws, followed into the route table, reaches the API console pre-filled and not the root catch-all;
- both mounts honour the preset: `component/developer/api-console` and `developer/api-console`;
- harness control: an app-less URL does reach the catch-all stand-in. `App.tsx`'s root table is not exported, so a probe stands in for its catch-all.

## Reverse proofs

Each proof ran through `../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, from committed state. Each anchor hit once (1 to 0). The restore was proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

1. **The old href restored** in `ToolPreview` (the pre-fix template string). **7 red:** six link pins in app-shell and the console end-to-end pin. The no-link, new-tab and harness-control pins stayed green. 7 failed and 21 passed of 28.
2. **The query read dropped** (the lazy initialiser returns null). **6 red:** every preset-dependent pin, including both mounts and end to end. The control and the ignore pins stayed green, as they should with no preset. 6 failed and 6 passed of 12.
3. **The `/api/` guard dropped.** **3 red:** absolute, protocol-relative, and outside `/api/`. The empty-value case stays green because the null check still refuses it. 3 failed and 9 passed of 12.

## Local verification (all at head `c0052db4f`)

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2`: 34 of 34 tasks successful. That includes app-shell's own `tsc && check-dist-completeness` build.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0. I counted with `--listFiles`: app-shell's `tsconfig.test.json` program includes `ToolPreview.test.tsx`, and the console's program includes the new test.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build` (`tsc && vite build && build:plugin`): exit 0. The post-build plugins reported: declared-lazy-views 11 of 12 lazy with 1 eager pinned, types-zod still lazy, eager-closure report emitted.
- Suites that name `ToolPreview`, `ApiConsolePage`, the preview registry, `registerDeveloperComponents` or the preview samples: 33 files and 404 tests passed.
- The whole previews directory: 61 files and 702 tests passed. The console test project: 119 files and 1305 tests passed.
- **NOT MEASURED: the full `@object-ui/app-shell` package test.** It has 799 test files, which does not fit the foreground cap. I declared it to CI's sharded `pnpm test`.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims` (the new changeset reads clean against itself, and no pending changeset names a touched file), `check:i18n-keys`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:eager-closure` (3048.5 KB of 3104.5 KB), `check:phantom-deps`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:self-import`.
- Lint on the four touched files, one run: 0 errors and 4 warnings. All four warnings are on lines this diff does not touch: two `no-explicit-any` in `ApiConsolePage` (`client: any` and the `catch (err: any)`), and two `exhaustive-deps` on `ToolPreview`'s existing `exampleArgs` `useMemo`. This is a narrowed run, and three facts back it:
  - the flat config applies to all four files (all four are in the results, none ignored);
  - the file count, 4, is read from `--format json`;
  - no type-aware linting is configured (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService` in `eslint.config.js`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Not probed in a running app.

## Acceptance notes

- The preset carries no request body. The execute endpoint takes `{ "parameters": ... }`, and the discovery catalog's `/tools/:toolName/execute` entry has that as its body template. The author types the body.
- The API console is registered only by `@object-ui/console`. A host that embeds app-shell without registering `developer:api-console` now lands on app-shell's "Component not registered" state for that key, not on its root.
- In the zero-app console, both candidate URLs fall to the "no apps" branches. Neither `component/...` nor `developer/...` is a system or metadata route. That was already the case before this change, and this change does not alter it.
- The designer gallery's tool card no longer shows the link, because the gallery mounts with no router and there is no app to open the console in.

## Findings (not fixed here; the seat files them)

- **class a**: `AgentPreview`'s "Try in chat" link is the hard-coded `/console/ai/agents/NAME/chat`, a plain anchor. The console's root route table declares `/ai/:agent` and `/ai/:agent/:conversationId`, and nothing under `/console`. So the root catch-all redirects it to `/`, the same failure this card had. I read this at the source and did not probe it in a running app. The agent is reachable from Studio, which lists agents through `metadata:resource` with `type: 'agent'`. Dedupe words: `AgentPreview Try in chat` · `console/ai/agents chat link` · `agent preview chat link redirects home`.
